entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: label_join expects at least 3 arguments (v, dst, separator[, src…]), got %d
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: label_join requires at least the vector, destination label, and separator arguments. Since cerberus issue #2449, lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp joins lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram and lowerLabelJoin as a third caller, but its own labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizer re-runs the identical `len(call.Args) < 3` check on the same parser Call before ever calling this function, so the claim is unaffected by the new caller.

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: label_replace requires exactly five arguments; labelReplaceAttributes is called only after the parser Call has been identified. Since cerberus issue #2449, lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp joins lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram and lowerLabelReplace as a third caller, but its own labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizer re-runs the identical `len(call.Args) != 5` check on the same parser Call before ever calling this function, so the claim is unaffected by the new caller.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s(%s) requires a string literal, got %T
entries.rationale: the parser typechecker admits only string literals in string-typed argument slots; PromQL has no other string-producing expression
